about: The setup steps, in order. The setup skill, bin/setup_record.py (the record and the rendered guide) and the session preload all read this file, so adding a step is an edit here. choices lists the only keys a step may record in core_text/setup.json.

steps.title: This guide
steps.does: Every step, how long it takes, and what can wait.
steps.why: See the whole path, then do what fits today.

steps.title: Check the basics
steps.does: Asks which computer you're on (Mac or Windows PC), then checks Python and Git and switches the plugin on for this project only.
steps.why: Commands differ between Mac and Windows, and the team's tools run on Python and Git.
steps.if_skipped: Not skippable: without Python the tools can't start.

steps.title: Where you read and edit Markdown
steps.does: Picks the app you'll open Markdown (.md) files in: we recommend Obsidian, and VS Code, Typora or Zed work too.
steps.why: Almost every file your agents read and write is Markdown, from your profile and plans to the worklog, rules and skills: it's the core file type here, not “notes”.
steps.if_skipped: You can open them in TextEdit (Mac) or Notepad (Windows), as raw text with no formatting, links or search.

steps.title: Obsidian (recommended)
steps.does: Opens this project as an Obsidian vault, with a ready-made worklog table and a short how-to (OBSIDIAN.md).
steps.why: Your whole project, every file and link, in one searchable place instead of a folder of files.
steps.if_skipped: Everything still works in your editor, without the vault view or the worklog table.

steps.title: GitHub (optional, strongly recommended)
steps.does: Connects this computer to a free GitHub account with GitHub's command-line tool.
steps.why: Every change is backed up off this computer and can be undone; it solves backup and lost-file problems for good, and it's free.
steps.if_skipped: Your project lives only on this computer, one lost laptop or bad edit away from gone; add it any time.

steps.title: Your starter workspace
steps.does: Adds your profile, worklog, rules and templates to this project.
steps.why: It's how every agent remembers you and what happened last session.
steps.if_skipped: Not skippable: the rest of setup writes into these files.

steps.title: Research extras (optional)
steps.does: Live documentation, web research and a cloud browser for your agents.
steps.why: Agents check today's docs and the web instead of guessing from memory.
steps.if_skipped: Agents use built-in web search; anything that needs a real browser comes back to you.
steps.cost: Free tiers; you create the accounts

steps.title: About you
steps.does: A short interview that fills in your profile.
steps.why: Agents read it every session, so they work your way from the first message.
steps.if_skipped: Agents use general defaults and won't know your goals or style.

steps.title: What to try first
steps.does: Three things to try with your new team.
steps.why: A small first win shows how the team works.
